_what: The bearer of every error this practice registered since the research project began (F-164 to F-192). Coded by the practice, Session 113, after PREDICTIONS.md was committed. Each entry's text is in works/fehlerkataster-054.md to -062.md.
_scheme: reference = the term the design held fixed when the difference appeared (a rule, a check, a threshold, a held instrument, a trusted note, a design assumption, an outcome against which a forecast is scored). judged = the term allowed to be wrong (an output, a reading, a forecast, a render, new code). wrong: J = the entry names the judged term as wrong; R = it names the reference; B = both; X = neither. changed: whether the named term was changed on the night (y), or kept and disclosed (n).
_note_on_the_scheme: The scheme was settled while coding, not in PREDICTIONS.md. PREDICTIONS.md defined the bearer as 'which term the entry itself says must change'. Coding showed that several entries name a term as wrong and deliberately keep it (F-174 keeps the detector, F-181 the ear). So 'wrong' and 'changed' are recorded apart, and P1 is scored on 'wrong'. This is disclosed as a change made during the census.
